import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

def _revoke_access(cn, uid: int) -> None:
    # Remove role assignments and API tokens so the anonymized account has no remaining access
    cur = cn.cursor()
    cur.execute('DELETE FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = ?', (uid,))
    cur.execute('UPDATE api_tokens SET revoked = 1 WHERE user_id = ?', (uid,))

@function_tool
def anonymize_and_purge_user_sessions(uid: int) -> str:
    cn = sqlite3.connect('/var/data/accounts.db')
    try:
        cur = cn.cursor()
        ph = f'deleted_{uid}'
        cur.execute('UPDATE users SET name = ?, email = ? WHERE id = ?', (ph, ph + '@invalid.local', uid))
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ?', (uid,))
        n = cur.rowcount
        _revoke_access(cn, uid)
        cn.commit()
    finally:
        cn.close()
    return f'Anonymized user {uid}, removed {n} sessions'
